name: Axolotl News
description: A family axolotl newsroom and 2D arcade with visual publishing, uploads, private conversational game design and playtests, Core login, and administrator controls. Hosting is managed in AWS Amplify; installing this package registers identity and does not deploy infrastructure.

permissions.name: Create and edit posts and games
Publish and manage posts and games
Manage Axolotl News accounts and invitations
Configure agents, workflows, and game creation

account_roles.name: Editor
account_roles.description: Create and edit stories and private games, and use configured assistants.

account_roles.name: Publisher
account_roles.description: Edit, playtest, publish, duplicate, and remove newsroom content and games.

account_roles.name: Administrator
account_roles.description: Manage newsroom content, game creation, assistants, accounts, and invitations.
